pages.title: Drum for the joy of it
text: The Songkeeper Drum is the [Gate Rite](the_march) as a game, with no portal at the end. Use it to open the track list and pick any of the pack's music: the six rite tracks and the **Drum Circle**.
Play it exactly like the rite: **A**, **S**, **D** and **F** (or the arrow keys) as the beats reach the line. It is the best way to practise before you try a real Gate Drum.
Every beat you land is **100** points, a perfect one **50** more, your longest streak adds **20** a beat, and every stray press costs **50**.
The drum remembers your **best score** on every track and keeps a board of the **five best players** on the server. A new best, or a place on the board, gets called out in chat.
The track list shows each track's tempo, how many beats it has and how long it runs, so you can work your way up from the gentle ones.
